description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three models, Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, in handling audio and noise data. The horizontal axis lists the model names in a fixed order, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model is represented by a pair of bars, with blue indicating audio and purple indicating noise, as per the legend. The accuracy for audio is approximately 29% for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, 35% for Audio-Reasoner, and 57% for Qwen-2.5-Omni, while for noise, it is around 22%, 29%, and 35%, respectively. A dashed gray line is visible at approximately 28% on the vertical axis, though its label is not specified. The bars are grouped by model, with no stacking or sorting applied beyond the fixed order of the models on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding provided by the legend.
